payload.title: Fix publication_modes_test: it loads scripts/priming-preview/fixtures.py which was never committed
payload.description: src/papyrus_content/publication_modes_test.py:35 loads scripts/priming-preview/fixtures.py, which does not exist in any commit. test_existing_papyrus_curation_can_be_vetted_with_explicit_publication_feedback_in_both_modes (4 params) fails with FileNotFoundError once pytest collects *_test.py files (found by PPY-c4e950). CI deselects it until the fixtures are committed or the test is rewritten.
